name: explainer-film
description: Make narrated, fact-checked explainer films for phone screens, chapter by chapter: research and script, voice and word timing, paintings turned into 3D rooms, cinematic pages timed to every spoken word, independent fact checks and critique by helper agents, filming and finishing; detailed 3D models built in Blender by script (with the official Blender MCP server), and a strict still-camera rule checked by measurement.
